+import os
+import django
+from django.conf import settings
+
+# Configure Django settings
+if not settings.configured:
+    settings.configure(
+        DEBUG=True,
+        DATABASES={
+            'default': {
+                'ENGINE': 'django.db.backends.sqlite3',
+                'NAME': ':memory:',
+            }
+        },
+        INSTALLED_APPS=[
+            'django.contrib.contenttypes',
+            'django.contrib.auth',
+        ],
+        SECRET_KEY='test-secret-key',
+    )
+    django.setup()
+
+from django.db import models
+import bisect
+
+# Define the models as described in the issue
+class A(models.Model):
+    class Meta:
+        abstract = True
+    myfield = models.IntegerField()
+
+class B(A):
+    class Meta:
+        app_label = 'test_app'
+
+class C(A):
+    class Meta:
+        app_label = 'test_app'
+
+# Test the bisect functionality
+b_field = B._meta.get_field('myfield')
+c_field = C._meta.get_field('myfield')
+
+# Create a list of fields and test bisect
+fields = []
+bisect.insort(fields, b_field)
+bisect.insort(fields, c_field)
+
+print(f"Fields after bisect: {fields}")
+print(f"Number of fields: {len(fields)}")
+print(f"Expected: 2, Got: {len(fields)}")
+
+# Test that fields are in the correct order
+print(f"Field 0: {fields[0]} (model: {fields[0].model})")
+print(f"Field 1: {fields[1]} (model: {fields[1].model})")
+
+# Test with different creation counters
+class D(models.Model):
+    class Meta:
+        abstract = True
+    field1 = models.IntegerField()
+    field2 = models.CharField(max_length=100)
+
+class E(D):
+    class Meta:
+        app_label = 'test_app'
+
+class F(D):
+    class Meta:
+        app_label = 'test_app'
+
+e_field1 = E._meta.get_field('field1')
+e_field2 = E._meta.get_field('field2')
+f_field1 = F._meta.get_field('field1')
+f_field2 = F._meta.get_field('field2')
+
+fields2 = []
+bisect.insort(fields2, e_field2)
+bisect.insort(fields2, e_field1)
+bisect.insort(fields2, f_field2)
+bisect.insort(fields2, f_field1)
+
+print(f"\nFields after bisect (with different creation counters):")
+for i, field in enumerate(fields2):
+    print(f"  {i}: {field} (creation_counter: {field.creation_counter}, model: {field.model})")
